title: 3PL warehouse for imported goods in Houston
assumptions: A new Texas LLC leases a warehouse in Houston, builds it out, hires staff and is importer of record for the goods it stores. No hazardous materials above fire code amounts.

items.name: Certificate of Formation (Texas LLC)
items.quote: Title 1, chapter 3, subchapter A of the BOC governs the formation of an LLC

items.name: Application for Employer Identification Number (EIN)
items.quote: You never have to pay a fee for an EIN.

items.name: Assumed Name Certificate (DBA)
items.condition: Only when trading under a name other than the legal name.
items.quote: a separate assumed name certificate must be filed for each assumed name.

items.name: Create/Update Importer Identity Form
items.quote: shall file CBP Form 5106 with the first formal entry.

items.name: Customs Bond
items.quote: unless a single entry or continuous bond on Customs Form 301, containing the bond conditions set forth in § 113.62 of this chapter,

items.name: ACE Secure Data Portal account for importers
items.quote: register an entity as an Importer of Record (IOR) in the Automated Commercial Environment (ACE)
items.match: \bcbp-ace\b|ace secure data portal account for importers

items.name: Texas Sales and Use Tax Permit Application
items.quote: You will need to apply using form AP-201, Texas Application (PDF) .
items.match: \btx-ap201\b|texas sales and use tax permit application

items.name: Certificate of Occupancy
items.agency: City of Houston, Houston Permitting Center
items.quote: The certificate is normally issued at the time of construction or when a remodel or change of use occurs.

items.name: Buildout permit (building permit for the space)
items.agency: City of Houston, Houston Permitting Center
items.quote: Buildout permits must be on-site for inspection.

items.name: Unemployment tax account
items.quote: register with the Texas Workforce Commission (TWC) within 10 days of becoming liable.

items.name: Workers' compensation, or the yearly non-subscriber notice
items.agency: Texas Department of Insurance, Division of Workers' Compensation
items.quote: Annual filing, between February 1 and April 30 each year.
items.match: \btx-workers-comp\b|workers' compensation, or the yearly non-subscriber notice

mustNotInclude.name: Any food permit, food handler or plan review
